text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Half-hourly national totals of the Physical Notifications (PNs) in the latest issue published before each half- hour. Orange: INDDEM, the PNs of the BMUs that plan to import, with the sign reversed to show demand as positive. Blue: INDGEN, the PNs of the BMUs that plan to export.'
text.tspan: Half-hourly national totals of the Physical Notifications (PNs) in the latest issue published before each half-
hour. Orange: INDDEM, the PNs of the BMUs that plan to import, with the sign reversed to show demand as positive.
Blue: INDGEN, the PNs of the BMUs that plan to export.
